rows.grounds: indicates flowers fallen on their own

items.question: What condition of flowers renders them unfit for ritual offering to Śaṅkara?
premises: Flowers that have fallen by themselves are unfit for offering.
Flowers that are damaged are unfit for offering.
Unfit flowers must be abandoned in ritual use.
items.inference: Both self-fallen and damaged flowers must be rejected as offerings.
items.plain_english: One should reject flowers that have fallen by themselves and those that are damaged.
